scope: Investigate four legacy 12K sampling context failures and two retained array-final replay failures without dropping facts, raising production budgets or changing production code.

baseline.method: git archive HEAD src exported as ordinary files into a separate temporary directory; a fresh Python process imported that entire HEAD source snapshot before pytest. Current test fixture files and installed fixed dependencies were used.
baseline.conclusion: All six failures also occur with complete HEAD product source; not newly caused by this repair candidate.

sampling.known_failure: Four final/pending_analysis cases across disabled/thinking_low raise ContextLimitError. The disabled/final diagnostic probe reached 12427 tokens at the tightest existing projection, above the explicit 12000 Run limit.
sampling.disposition: Original tests and their 12K assertions are unchanged; these remain known baseline capacity failures. No production context optimization, scientific-fact removal, xfail marker or budget increase was introduced.

frozen_configuration_probe.method: Intercept only context construction in the existing synthetic fixture to capture its full Request/Run/Plan/Result/feedback objects. First reproduce the legacy small-budget error. Copy the Run, replace only configuration and BudgetLimits with the already selected frozen runtime.toml values, then build context and validate every named scientific/evidence fact.

Initial probe assertions assumed compact checked_count and top-level source digests; corrected to validate the equally explicit names/rules and nested full source-digest forms produced by the larger budget. No source facts were weakened.

array_final.cause: The replay copied persisted final Run.processed_feedback, including the very Result marked related/new in the archived model request. Existing consumed-read display logic then treated all three reads as consumed and elided the oldest body. This reconstructed the wrong time point.
array_final.test_only_fix: Set replay Run.processed_feedback to the selected original result_ids minus archived AUTHORITY.related_results before build_context. The new Result stays new; all three original observation bodies remain available.
array_final.historical_evidence: The test retains existing before/after hashes for every archived JSON and immutable input object; original live records were not rewritten.
